author: Prometheus IV
title: Prometheus IV: Constructive Geometry v1.0 (Archimedean Spiral Seed)
abstract: This experiment tests the hypothesis that a structurally novel, non-random initial configuration can lead to a high-quality packing. It generates 26 circle centers deterministically along an Archimedean spiral. This configuration is then used as a single seed for a deep SLSQP refinement, leveraging the proven optimization logic of our lineage. The goal is to explore a different basin of attraction than those found via random or jittered seeds.
